title: Design System: The System Design Atlas

technical.purpose: Code metadata, state values, and measurements only.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Hover, focus-adjacent, and simulator state changes.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single next action in an editorial section.

components.name: Reference Input
components.description: A readable filter or custom-input field for dense tools.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:6px;color:#625D52;font:14px system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-field input{min-height:44px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid #C9C0AE;border-radius:2px;background:#FFFDF7;color:#211F1A;font:16px system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #C8542F;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Editorial Index Row
components.description: The default structure for paths, stages, and published lessons.
components.css: .ds-index{display:grid;grid-template-columns:36px 1fr auto;gap:16px;align-items:center;padding:18px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #C9C0AE;color:#211F1A;text-decoration:none}.ds-index>span,.ds-index small{color:#625D52;font:12px ui-monospace,monospace}.ds-index strong{display:block;font:700 20px Georgia,serif}.ds-index i{font-style:normal}.ds-index:hover strong{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-index:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #C8542F;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Tool Panel
components.description: A square, high-contrast instrument surface for practice and simulation.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-tool{padding:16px;border:1px solid #474137;border-radius:2px;background:#24211B;color:#F2ECDE;font:16px/1.6 system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-tool h3{margin:0 0 8px;font:700 24px Georgia,serif}.ds-tool p{color:#C8BEAB}.ds-tool button{min-height:44px;padding:8px 16px;border:1px solid #EF7650;border-radius:2px;background:#EF7650;color:#191814}.ds-tool button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #79A88E;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Artwork Plate
components.description: A protected topic or article-specific image with a precise rule frame.

narrative.overview: The Atlas looks like an authored technical reference that has been used at a desk, not a generic software dashboard. Warm paper, charcoal, fine rules, real diagrams, protected subject-specific artwork, and editorial typography give the work a human and practical character. Reading pages are deliberately quiet. Indexes are denser and more structured. Simulators and practice areas feel like instruments.

rules.name: Rare Accent
rules.body: Orange identifies the next meaningful action. If many orange elements compete, reduce them.

rules.name: Editorial First
rules.body: Serif establishes hierarchy, sans explains, and monospace reports data.

rules.name: Rule Before Shadow
rules.body: Use a rule or tonal shift before adding elevation.

dos: Do make published content and the next useful action obvious.
Do preserve subject-specific banners and diagrams.
Do use sentence case for normal interface copy.
donts: Don't return to navy fields, indigo glows, glass panels, or decorative grids.
Don't build pages from nested cards or walls of pills.
Don't use generic coding or AI artwork.
